title: Hoshino Ichika — Starry Steps〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Is everyone ready? Alright, everyone, it's time for us to set off! Are you ready for this?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You make it sound like we're going on some epic adventure. It's just a florist shop, you know?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I've been looking forward to this day for so long♪ Hona and Shiho, you've both been there before, right?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. A few times before. Not as often as Ichika, of course.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah. Ichika was a regular customer there.
And she would always be thinking about what flowers to bring next, too.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes. Usually, I would just buy the flowers I already had my eye on...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But I often included flowers recommended by the florist lady too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh! I often hear you talk about her.
She must be such a nice lady!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
She is. She regularly gave me discounts, too.
I think it may have been her way of showing concern for me.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I see!
Hehe, I can't wait to meet her.
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Florist Lady
rows.Line:
Oh my, is that Ichika?
You're back for more flowers?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yes, it's me.
Um, I brought my childhood friends along with me today.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hello. Long time no see.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hello...

rows.Speaker: Florist Lady
rows.Line: My! It's been a while since I saw the both of you!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You remember us, too?

rows.Speaker: Florist Lady
rows.Line:
Of course I do.
And you've all grown so much in the short period of time we haven't met! Hm?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, h-hello!
My name is Saki Tenma.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thank you for all those pretty flowers I've received! As you can see, I'm in the pink of health now♪

rows.Speaker: Florist Lady
rows.Line:
Ah, so you were the one they got flowers for!
I've been hoping to meet you one day.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Me too! The flowers Ichi brought during her visits were all so lovely. I always looked forward to receiving them!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, please take a look at this!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: These are pressed flowers I made from the ones I received!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Not all of them, though.
I asked my mom to make them for me.

rows.Speaker: Florist Lady
rows.Line: My, my... I can tell you really cherished those flowers. Thank you, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Florist Lady
rows.Line:
I'm so glad you've recovered from your illness.
I know it couldn't have been easy.

rows.Speaker: Florist Lady
rows.Line: You really did well.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe, thanks!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, but it wasn't that bad at all!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I just kept thinking about the fun things I would do with my friends after I can go back to school again, and that would always put me in a good mood!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Saki...)

rows.Speaker: Florist Lady
rows.Line: Hehe. Well then, are you having fun now?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yes! Every day feels very bright!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Um, Ms. Florist?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The next time I come, I'll be getting flowers for birthdays and other celebrations instead of for hospital visits.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey, that sounds great! I'll do that too!

rows.Speaker: Florist Lady
rows.Line: You're always welcome here.

rows.Speaker: Florist Lady
rows.Line: I'll even give you a discount the next time!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Really?! Did you all hear that?
She's going to give us discounts!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yes, I heard the first time.
Don't get carried away now.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm not getting carried away, nope!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Let's buy lots of flowers together from now on, Saki.)
